verdict.rationale: Poly is a cloud file-storage and AI-agent service, so self-hosting the core product is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment option. Its own docs describe a hosted service: files sync to Poly storage, and the MCP server lives at mcp.poly.app behind OAuth to Poly. The local CLI and desktop sync folder are clients of that hosted service, not a self-hosted core.
